title: quick-glazed jamaican pork burger
description: a quick fix jamaican dish featuring pork chops. this recipe is peppery, aerated, and ovo-vegetarian friendly.

ingredients.name: coconut oil
ingredients.notes: for greasing the grill or pan

instructions: preheat a grill or grill pan to 400°f.
in a small bowl, mix together brown sugar, jamaican jerk seasoning, soy sauce, and hot sauce.
coat the pork chops evenly with the glaze, making sure they're fully coated.
dust the pork chops with flour, shaking off any excess.
dip the floured pork chops in beaten eggs, making sure they're fully coated.
coat the egg-washed pork chops evenly with breadcrumbs.
place the coated pork chops on the preheated grill or grill pan.
cook the pork chops for 5-7 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°f.
while the pork chops are cooking, toast the buns on the grill or in a toaster.
assemble the burgers by placing a cooked pork chop on each bun.
top with coleslaw, bacon, and any other desired toppings.
